title: openstax-llm chunk record
description: One line of a JSONL dataset exported by openstax-llm. Every chunk retains enough provenance to be cited back to its source textbook.

chunk_id.description: Unique within a book. Formatted as '<section>-c<index>', e.g. '1.2-c003'. Falls back to 'chunk-<index>' when the module has no section number.

text.description: Markdown source with intact LaTeX. Inline math uses $...$ and display math uses $$...$$; neither is ever split across a chunk boundary.

chapter.description: Chapter number derived from the section hierarchy. Empty when the section has no dot.

section.description: Section number, e.g. '1.2'. Empty for chunk text produced without a section.

section_title.description: Human-readable title of the module the chunk came from.

chunk_type.description: Pedagogical role detected for the chunk. 'prose' is the fallback.

token_est.description: Heuristic token estimate, computed as word_count * 1.3 for technical and mathematical text.

metadata.description: Extensible key-value bag for downstream vector indexes. Empty by default; openstax-llm itself writes nothing here.
